body.content: Speculative counterfactual: all five foundations assume the grounded extension is the correct substrate for diagnostics. But what if the grounded extension is too coarse? A node suspended due to a 3-cycle of mutual attacks has a different 'standing reason' than a node suspended due to an accepted attacker, yet both are UNDECIDED. The diagnostic overlays try to fix this, but they inherit the fixpoint's information loss: the fixpoint only outputs labels, not the reasons. So any post-hoc explanation is a reconstruction, not a recovery. This suggests the diagnostics are fundamentally underdetermined.
body.possible_next_move: Try to construct a graph where two different post-hoc explanations are both consistent with the same grounded extension.
body.why_keep_this: Challenges the recoverability assumption shared by SRC_003, SRC_012, SRC_005.
